info.title: Touch Cursor Overlay
info.details: Experimental accessibility overlay for modded Nintendo Switch consoles with broken touchscreens. Move the cursor with either stick; A taps or holds, ZR drags, X recenters, and B closes. Requires Atmosphere, nx-ovlloader, and Ultrahand/Tesla. It injects virtual touch via hid:dbg. On HOS 14+ it attempts to suppress ordinary controller navigation in the foreground while visible and restore it on exit; it does not change global keybind files. Virtual touch has been observed on HOS 20.5.0 / Atmosphere 1.11.1 / Ultrahand 2.4.1, but the new pad filter and other setups need confirmation. This is a prerelease. Do not run alongside sys-botbase or another touchscreen AutoPilot tool. Extract the release ZIP to the SD root.
info.author: jabatista14
info.description: Touch cursor for damaged Switch screens

changelog: Initial store candidate: joystick cursor, virtual taps and drags, clean exit, visual error warnings, and temporary foreground pad-input filter.
